create_TtyrecDataset: create a TtyrecDataset to iterate over NetHack ttyrec game recordings from a named dataset
iterate_TtyrecDataset_minibatches: iterate over a TtyrecDataset to yield minibatches of tty_chars, tty_colors, and cursor tensors
fetch_get_ttyrecs: fetch chunked tensor data for multiple game IDs using the get_ttyrecs method
fetch_get_ttyrec: fetch chunked tensor data for a single game ID using the get_ttyrec method
query_get_meta: query game metadata for a given game ID using the get_meta method on TtyrecDataset
